name: Top Ramen Masala Noodles
ingredients_raw: NOODLES (91%): Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil), Iodised Salt, Acidity Regulators [INS 451(i) & INS 500(i)], Mixed Spices 0.17% (Turmeric, Coriander, Cumin & Red Chilli), Antioxidant (INS 319) & Thickener (INS 412). SEASONING MIX (9%): Sugar, Mixed Spices 17.51% (Coriander, Turmeric, Cumin, Red Chilli, Ginger, Fenugreek, Black Pepper, Clove, Cinnamon, Green Cardamom, Nutmeg & Star Anise), Iodised Salt, Hydrolysed Vegetable Protein Powder (Soya), Onion Powder, Noodle Powder (Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil), Iodised Salt, Acidity Regulators [INS 451(i) & INS 500(i)], Mixed Spices 0.17% (Turmeric, Coriander, Cumin & Red Chilli), Antioxidant (INS 319) & Thickener (INS 412)), Corn Starch, Garlic Powder, Flavour Enhancers (INS 631 & INS 627), Yeast Extract Powder, Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Colour [INS 100(ii)] & Natural Flavour.
